title: The AI Compendium
credit: Erze, with Rain, Phish3r, Blackmyst and QuantizedAnson
scope: Community-reported companion behavior, not independently reproduced here. Style suggestions apply after Master Traits unlock; they are not complete AI presets. Keep Defender and the progression unlock limits when adapting them.

captain.note: Consider Insight for damage-skill shortcuts into Power Raise. The compendium reports less effective use of Essence's Combat Healer loop; check actual healing and party support before copying the manual support build.
captain.caution: More cooldown reduction can also mean more skill casts replacing Power Raise during Link Time. Compare finished attacks, not just cooldowns.

katalina.note: Consider Insight for Ares uptime. The compendium reports that skill priority limits Pactstrike use, while Essence's more involved combo loop is less reliable on AI.
katalina.caution: Do not remove cooldown reduction solely to force more normal attacks: the reported Insight loop still benefits from skills. Watch whether Ares needs rebuilding after boss transitions.

rackam.note: Consider Insight or Crux for general companion use. The compendium reports that Essence can spend most of the fight channeling Coffinmaker, making it a specialized farming choice rather than a general default.
rackam.caution: Its Crux comparisons depend on landing Collateral Damage. Do not copy the source's low-HP assumptions into a Defender build without checking survival and HP-dependent effects.

io.note: Consider Essence with Fire and Freeze. The compendium reports that AI does not use Quick Cast well and can repeatedly prioritize Lightning; its companion setup instead uses Flowery Seven and Gravity Well alongside Fire and Freeze.
io.caution: Watch completed charge casts and interruptions before changing equipment. The source also reports an FPS-dependent Gravity Well bug; its stun results do not establish ordinary performance. The manual Lightning reaction build remains separate.

eugen.note: Consider Insight for charged shots and damage skills rather than assuming AI reproduces the manual Essence grenade loop. The compendium even leaves a skill slot empty to allow more normal attacks.
eugen.caution: Sumrak and Armor-Piercing Round depend on target movement and hitbox. An empty AI skill slot is a deliberate alternative to assess, not a missing fourth skill in the manual build.

rosetta.note: Consider Insight for the Lost Love and Spiral Rose reset loop. The compendium uses Bouquet to help rose positioning rather than expecting AI to reproduce the manual placement plan.
rosetta.caution: Watch whether roses and skill hits actually reach mobile bosses. Animation commitment can also delay Link Attacks or SBA; theoretical cooldown resets do not guarantee useful damage.

charlotta.note: Consider Insight's Noble Stance route. The compendium reports that AI does not reproduce the manual XYY sequence and has trouble positioning Sword of Lumiel; Essence's parry stack plan is also a poor fit.
charlotta.caution: Stout Heart may help attack commitment, but the source reports fewer dodge-based SBA gains with invulnerability setups. Evaluate survival and team SBA timing together.

ghandagoza.note: Consider Crux for general use and Essence for a team built around Link Time. The compendium emphasizes landing charged fists and preventing interruptions rather than copying a manual counter sequence.
ghandagoza.caution: Mobile bosses can still make committed punches miss. Its Essence shield and low-HP setup needs a separate gear plan; do not enable its HP conversion while retaining incompatible high-HP effects.

ferry.note: Consider Essence's departing-pet route. The compendium reports that AI skill priority interrupts jump-slam sequences, so a manual rotation's damage should not be assumed for a companion.
ferry.caution: Removing every skill also prevents useful pet generation. The source reports that Stout Heart can make AI commit to charged normals instead of the desired jump attacks; watch the actual loop.

narmaya.note: Consider Essence with Apex of Nothingness. The compendium reports that AI leaves this counter unused during Link Time, helping preserve Kaleidoscope while other damage skills are on cooldown.
narmaya.caution: Butterfly refunds still vary between runs. Warpath's SBA penalty remains real; compare team chain timing rather than automatically spending several slots to offset it.

lancelot.note: Consider Essence for a simpler companion loop, or a dedicated Schwertgeist support setup. The compendium reports positioning problems with damage skills and missed attacks against moving targets.
lancelot.caution: Mirror Image can reduce dodge-based SBA procs. Adjust SBA support to the whole party instead of assuming more invulnerability always means faster chains.

vane.note: Consider Crux for Beatdown damage. The compendium presents both Beatdown-focused and skill-focused options rather than one universally strongest companion loadout.
vane.caution: Long skill animations and buff casts can displace finishers. Its specialized Crabvestment setup and weapon HP conditions are not requirements for our Defender progression path.

percival.note: The compendium favors Essence, but explicitly bases part of its performance on a reported version-2.0.6 interaction between Roter Wirbel and held Zerreissen that bypasses normal damage limits.
percival.caution: Treat this as a bug-dependent comparison, not proof that Essence is normally strongest. We have not reproduced it, and the author's idea that an ATK modifier changes AI skill priority is explicitly speculative.

siegfried.note: Consider Insight for sustained Perfect Executions; Crux is a separate team-dependent alternative. The compendium limits equipped skills to reduce interruptions of normal attack chains.
siegfried.caution: Innate Stout Heart makes attack commitment easier but can increase incoming damage and debuffs. More skill cooldown reduction is not automatically better if it displaces Perfect Executions.

cagliostro.note: Consider Crux for progression support. The compendium reports poor AI use of manual Super Collapse techniques and offers Insight damage-over-time builds only against suitable enemies.
cagliostro.caution: AI may recast buffs or healing during Link Time even when their immediate benefit is small. Keep support skills for the team role rather than judging them by personal damage alone.

yodarha.note: Consider Insight for a simpler companion route. The compendium reports that AI does not use the unique Y parry needed for Crux and interrupts finisher chains when skills become ready.
yodarha.caution: Hymn of the Hundreds helps survival but can reduce dodge-based SBA procs. The source also cautions that Stout Heart can consume Mirror Image stacks faster through additional hit commitment.

zeta.note: Consider Insight's loop route rather than the manual Rhapsody counter plan. The compendium distinguishes Rank 2 for mobile targets from Rank 3 setups that need time to build five Loopmaster stacks.
zeta.caution: Rank 3 is not an unconditional AI upgrade against moving bosses. The source reports vulnerable Arvess Hammer animations, so check both completed loops and survival.

vaseraga.note: Consider Essence to shorten charged finishers and improve their chance of landing. The compendium reports greater variance with Insight and longer ramp time with Crux.
vaseraga.caution: Stationary windows still matter: shorter charges do not solve a target moving away. Account for existing Grynoth Stout Heart before spending equipment slots to duplicate it.

beatrix.note: Consider Essence for AI clock usage. The compendium reports a preference for yellow clock outside burst windows and red clock during Link Time or Chain Burst, with a separate Insight option for more stun.
beatrix.caution: Its results depend on actual clock cycling and finished power finishers. Do not assume AI can execute the manual Crux skill-chain plan or preserve its intended skill availability.

eustace.note: Consider Crux for Grade IV shots and Perfectionist stacks. The compendium reports effective skill and reload use, while Essence can lose Heaven Comes Down to interruptions.
eustace.caution: The source reports that Crux keeps dodging even with Stout Heart, an exception to its general AI rule. This has not been reproduced here; watch stack retention and dodging in your own fights.

id.note: Consider Essence for a simpler Dragonform-focused companion loop; Crux is presented as a stun-oriented alternative. The compendium reports poor AI execution of Insight's Godmight rotation.
id.caution: Do not carry Versalis Heart into a Dragonform-only plan without checking its gauge effect. Avoid stacking optional max-HP penalties just because an endgame AI damage setup uses them.

sandalphon.note: Consider Insight for easier Archangel access. The compendium reports that AI does not reliably use the manual Revontulet shortcut or spam Zohar during Link Time.
sandalphon.caution: A manual combo's theoretical output is not companion output. Essence's finisher requirement can delay transformation, so compare time spent in Archangel form rather than only its peak bonuses.

seofon.note: Consider Essence for Link Time damage. The compendium reports stronger stun with Insight but an AI tendency to attempt Infinito Creare hold before Avatar Finisher, increasing interruptions outside Link Time.
seofon.caution: Its cooldown targets depend on a particular Ispirazione setup. Do not treat those values as universal progression requirements; watch actual buff gaps and completed finishers.

tweyen.note: The compendium reports incomplete Multilock charges and weak use of placement-dependent skills. Its Essence recommendation is a specialized Beelzebub damage-over-time setup, not general companion advice.
tweyen.caution: Do not replace the manual Insight build with this niche setup. The source's attack-stacking and death/reset assumptions need separate testing and are not Defender progression targets.

fraux.note: Consider Insight for a straightforward companion route. The compendium favors Kick Face over Power Plant because the latter's movement and animation can lose attack time, and uses interruption protection to help complete Dead Lands.
fraux.caution: Check the team's status plan before combining frequent Burn with Glaciate. The source also reports FPS-dependent SBA generation; its results should not be assumed identical across frame rates.

fediel.note: Consider Essence for a debuff-oriented companion. Although the current manual mechanic uses five stacks, the compendium reports that AI still claws at least ten times before the enhanced finisher under version 2.0.6.
fediel.caution: That observation describes AI behavior, not a ten-stack requirement: keep the official five-stack correction. Watch fully charged Sphere of Reversal hits against mobile enemies.

gallanza.note: Consider Crux for skills and Flashpoint. The compendium avoids Turbine perks in this particular setup because spinning displaces the intended skill loop.
gallanza.caution: Long boss downtime can remove Deathmatch Finale, and the source reports weaker stun contribution. Select teammates for the encounter's checks instead of treating personal damage as the only requirement.

maglielle.note: Consider Crux for Blade Dance and shield uptime. The compendium reports effective Blade Dance chains but inconsistent combo-finisher selection and less effective AI use of Essence animation cancels.
maglielle.caution: Sostenuto is presented as a short-fight option; repeated casts can displace Blade Dance in long fights. The reported improved Crux dodging is an observation, not independently verified behavior here.
